'''Corso Riggs's fiancée''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. She was the fiancée of [[Corso Riggs]], after he first asked permission from her father and then had a few chaperoned dates between their families. However, after Corso's entire family was killed in the [[Separatist War]] he ran away and never saw her again.<ref>{{TORcite|type=conversation|Corso Riggs|Courting a Captain}}</ref>
